checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered original-loss U-Net proof and exact source corpus/role binding. No seed/scene/reader losses.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same-corpus source-only parent frozen at fixed 24000 prior updates. Fit sees only U and the U-Net, no W24, TX, V, target, practical, or trace.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at 9000 additional steps. The actual half readout must strictly beat all five controls on the six-scene correct count, meet all five on low urban, and meet direct on clean. Qualified only: three predefined Full target shards and independent truth-last.

execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on wrong role, failed branch gradients/numerics, source baseline mismatch, missing artifacts or prediction mismatch. Preserve artifacts and other jobs.

notes: Hypothesis: preserving local normalized complex relationships can avoid the identification penalty of broad averaged waveform error. Compute exact same-source relative adjacent signed-bin coherence and adjacent chirp coherence of the actual half readout in a shared legal source frame. Each direction averages four non-DC bands by absolute FFT bin (1-8, 9-32, 33-80, 81-192), source support weighted. Both arms report both losses.

Candidate replaces the diagnostic-only auxiliary with a .35 weighted edit-output gradient. Compute base and auxiliary gradients with respect to each complex full waveform before the shared backward. For each observation, remove the auxiliary component with negative real inner product against the base, and cap to base norm. The direct time-path loss gradients remain as chosen in the base objective. This is an output-space property, not a guarantee for parameter-space steps.

Same source U source data, two generic independently disturbed views, original weak detail probe, two clean identity rows; 20,000 fit U, 500 held U, 0 calibration. Coherence only for the two separately disturbed observations, excluding the clean and weak-probe rows in fit. No W24, TX, V, target, practical, or trace in fit or freeze.

Freeze at 9000 warm updates. All controls are fixed before W24. Full source 300 same packets seven views, truth last. Candidate must beat matched warm control, source U-Net parent, original long DURA, outer DURA, and direct on six, hold all matched low urban and direct clean. Only then Full main 30,000 packets, three frozen shards, independent scoring.
